lines.t: My God, my God, you are holy
O my Redeemer, my beloved Savior
Yahushua, by your blood am I washed
From sin's raiment, which had clothed me in death
By Your sacrifice You freed me
Your great love has broken my bonds
Behold, a new light has appeared
Where once there was only darkness
The flame which flickered burns bright once again
For in my heart you have kindled a fire
And your words, Lord, your beautiful words
They are truly a lamp for my feet
And by following your teaching
I have begun to un-live in my life
Though by Your sacrifice You have already freed me
From the power of sin
Oh Lord, You are my righteousness
I will obey Your Word
And though I stumble, I will not cease from striving to obey
I wanna do what is pleasing in your sight
Help me walk in your ways
But in my heart you have kindled a fire And your words, Lord, your beautiful words
They are truly a lamp for my feet And by following your teaching
I have begun to unleaven my life
